Free tools for the Class of 2026

Land the job, without the guesswork.

Four free, no-login tools built for recent and soon-to-be graduates. Sharpen your resume, find early-career roles, write your cover letter, and practice for the interview.

The tools

Resume Optimizer

Paste your resume and get honest, specific feedback — weak verbs, thin metrics, formatting snags, and the gaps recruiters notice first.

Job Finder

Search early-career openings filtered for new graduates, with H-1B sponsorship signals and direct links straight to the employer.

Cover Letter Builder

Turn a job posting and a few details about you into a focused, genuine cover letter — no clichés, no filler, ready to send.

Interview Practice

Practice answering interview questions one at a time, using examples from projects, internships, work, or volunteering.
